tasks.subject: Task 1: Purge history and force-push
tasks.description:
Goal: history without backup/, Adafruit_*, .vscode, .DS_Store.

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "git rev-list --all --objects | grep -ciE 'ical|backup/feedback|Adafruit_|\\.DS_Store|\\.vscode'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["grep count is 0", "15 commits preserved", "force-push ok"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Monorepo layout, version.h, merged-image script
tasks.description:
Goal: firmware/ builds both envs and emits tasky-<env>-merged.bin.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["firmware/platformio.ini", "firmware/tasky/version.h", "firmware/tasky/config_secrets.h.example", "firmware/scripts/merge_bin.py", "firmware/tasky/ota_service.cpp", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "ls firmware/.pio/build/xiao_c*/tasky-*-merged.bin", "acceptanceCriteria": ["both envs compile", "merged bins exist, byte0 e9", "version 2.4.0"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: CI and release workflows
tasks.description:
Goal: ci.yml matrix + release.yml on tags.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/ci.yml", ".github/workflows/release.yml"], "verifyCommand": "gh run watch --exit-status", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CI green C3+C6", "tag/version check", "assets named tasky-<env>-vX.Y.Z.bin + SHA256SUMS"]}
```

tasks.description:

```json:metadata
{"files": ["README.md", "README.es.md", "LICENSE", "CONTRIBUTING.md", "CHANGELOG.md", "docs/MANUAL.md", "docs/HARDWARE.md", "docs/BUILDING.md", "docs/CUSTOMIZING.md", "docs/ARCHITECTURE.md", "docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rnE 'TaskyCircular|EverySecondCounts|7x16|no Makefile' README*.md docs/*.md CONTRIBUTING.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["grep empty", "every Screen documented", "pinout matches config_hardware.h", ">=12 improvement proposals"]}
```
